seed: A click on a Library tile in a picture document shows it picked in the frame the click lands in, for a component tile and a colour tile, at Next defaults with no flag set. Each click is made by the pointer and timed from letting go to the first frame on screen with the tile picked, and to the window drawing on time again once the dock's section for it is open. Any click whose picked frame takes 33ms or longer, or whose dock takes 100ms or longer, fails the walk (the user, 2026-10-10: a noticeable lag on every click).

steps.comment: A colour on the shelf to click: the box's fill dragged onto the Library and named Brand.

steps.note: THE FIRST TEST: the Brand colour tile on the Styles shelf, clicked ten times from nothing picked, shows picked within 33ms every time and the dock is ready within 100ms

steps.comment: Measured, not judged: a tile clicked while a layer is picked also closes that layer's sections in the dock.

steps.note: Two starter component tiles, Button and Card, clicked ten times each from nothing picked and then ten times each going from one to the other, every click shown picked within 33ms
A double click still places: the first click picks the tile at once and the second puts a Card on the canvas, picked, with its Component section in the dock and not the tile's
